information: Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ## First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules. ## Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
